name: munchkin-confirm
description: Confirmation of the dive-styles-early munchkin result on 200 fresh seeds
prespecified: Fixed before any confirm-200 run. Primary: deaths before the 100,000-turn cap, munchkin-d6 against default on the same version, one test per version (pristine, bbc-m4): exact McNemar on the paired seeds, two-sided, alpha 0.05. Secondary: munchkin-d10 against default, median max depth, reaching DL10, operational outcomes. Stalls, timeouts and crashes are reported per arm and are not deaths.
